selection: After-run selection: two positive examples, both abstentions and the failed abstention. Not an accuracy sample.
canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(comma,colon); no trailing newline
included: Exact question, explicit scope, answer, abstention, validation labels, all cited chunk texts/context, selected timing and reviewer verdict/note.
excluded: Full request/response/debug logs, uncited retrieval contexts, original store, credentials, local paths and shared-budget history.
limitations: Integrity within this published sample is locally checkable. Upstream hashes are provenance references, not independently verified execution or a cryptographic attestation. Full-panel metrics are reported from the local run, not recomputed from these five cases.
